patterns.note: The hero section employs an asymmetrical layout, positioning descriptive text and a call-to-action on the left, balanced by a large, expressive hand-drawn illustration on the right.
A vibrant, warm orange is consistently used as a primary accent color, prominently featured in calls-to-action, key illustrations, and a large, abstract decorative graphic in the footer.
A persistent top navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility and access to primary navigation links as the user scrolls down the page.

Major content sections are clearly delineated by alternating full-width background colors (white, light off-white, and a solid orange) or by full-bleed photographic elements, creating distinct visual breaks.

technique_notes: The main navigation is implemented as a sticky header, allowing it to remain visible and accessible at the top of the browser window while the page content scrolls underneath.
Content sections are visually separated by applying full-width background colors or images, with the textual and interactive elements contained within a consistent maximum content width.
Service offerings and informational articles are presented in a grid-based layout using distinct cards, each featuring a solid background color, a clear heading, and a concise description.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and range from a large display size for the hero (~3-4x body) to medium section titles (~2x body), with body text being a comfortable reading size.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (4-8px) is applied to buttons and card corners, contributing to a friendly and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more airy feel in the hero and footer areas, creating a clear visual hierarchy.

standout: This site distinguishes itself by blending professional healthcare information with a remarkably playful and approachable visual style. This is primarily achieved through its vibrant orange color palette and charming, hand-drawn illustrations that convey empathy and support rather than clinical seriousness. The large, abstract orange graphic in the footer further reinforces this unique brand personality.
